RemediationStrings.Title: The Engramic Baseline isn't installed on this device.
RemediationStrings.Description: IT needs to install the Engramic Baseline so this device can be checked. Contact IT.

RemediationStrings.Title: This device hasn't been checked for Cyber Essentials recently (last check {ActualValue} hours ago).
RemediationStrings.Description: Leave the device switched on and connected for a while so the daily check can run. If this keeps happening, contact IT.

RemediationStrings.Title: This device has {ActualValue} issue(s) that automatically fail Cyber Essentials.
RemediationStrings.Description: These are usually missing security updates or out-of-date apps. Install all updates in Settings > Windows Update, update your apps, then restart. Open 'Engramic Baseline' from the Start menu to see what needs fixing, or contact IT.

RemediationStrings.Title: This device's version of Windows is no longer supported.
RemediationStrings.Description: Install the latest Windows 11 feature update from Settings > Windows Update, or contact IT.

RemediationStrings.Title: Virus protection on this device is off or out of date.
RemediationStrings.Description: Open Windows Security > Virus & threat protection, make sure protection is on and check for protection updates. Open 'Engramic Baseline' from the Start menu to see what needs fixing, or contact IT.
